records.title: Binance Hot Wallet Exploit: Aave's Response — updated 13:49 UTC
records.summary: LlamaRisk reports that the exploiter supplied 60M USDT to Aave V3 Ethereum Core and borrowed 19,762 WETH worth about $44.6M. It states the position held $59.9M USDT collateral against $43.8M debt, was overcollateralized and did not put suppliers at risk. Aave risk contributors and Aave Labs froze 175 V3 reserves across 16 networks and 117 V4 reserves across four networks including Arc spokes; no market was paused. Users could repay/withdraw and liquidations continued. The 13:49 UTC update reports temporary rate/cap changes, $3.7B V3 and $130M V4 unused borrowing capacity removed, and a four-wave unfreeze plan with LTV/collateral-factor 0 on exploited assets.
records.limitations: LlamaRisk is an Aave risk contributor and forum participant, not an independent auditor. The position's exact health factor is not disclosed. The reported overcollateralized status is more proximate to Aave state than Elliptic's earlier 'near liquidation' characterization, but remains a protocol-side statement.

records.title: Aave Protocol Changelog — Aave V4 Arc market
records.summary: The Aave changelog records the Aave V4 Arc market launch on September 16, 2026. It describes Arc as Circle's USDC-native Layer 1 and identifies the Arc market as a live deployment.
records.limitations: The changelog confirms deployment timing but does not by itself provide a complete current reserve list or current utilization snapshot.

records.title: Aave V4 on Arc successfully activated
records.summary: Aave Labs states Aave V4 on Arc was successfully activated and is live and accessible through pro.aave.com. The initial reserves are USDC, EURC, cirBTC and WETH. XRP is not in the initial reserve roster.
records.limitations: The initial reserve roster does not prove XRP can never be listed in a future proposal. No XRP collateral or XRP reserve is established by this source.

records.title: Binance drained in suspected hack; Tether and Circle freeze $1.8B
records.summary: Decrypt reports Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire said Circle froze more than $800M USDC associated with the incident in coordination with law enforcement. The article's on-chain tally reports approximately 823M USDC frozen in the main receiving wallet. It also distinguishes issuer-level token blocking from assets that cannot be frozen by token issuers.
records.limitations: The CEO quote is reported by Decrypt; the direct X post was not independently retrieved in this run. The 823M figure is an on-chain tally, not a separate Circle audit.

records.title: Security Incident Update #2
records.summary: Binance's verified account says it reserved more than $6.34B in company funds, with $5B held in exact impacted token assets (about 80%), and is buying the remaining 20% through market and OTC channels. It targets phased withdrawal restoration in approximately 34 hours subject to security checks, an initial PoR snapshot in 12 hours and results by Monday 2026-11-02.
records.limitations: This is a company statement, not an independent audit or proof of completed replenishment. It does not disclose an XRP-specific allocation, execution venue or amount.

records.title: Aave V4 on Arc: three addresses hold 85.4% of the USDC
records.summary: CleanSky's September 24 on-chain analysis reports approximately $143.4M USDC in the Aave V4 Arc Main Spoke, with three unlabeled addresses holding about $122.5M (85.4%). It reports Arc at approximately $180.4M, or 28.6% of Aave V4's approximately $631.6M TVL at that snapshot. The analysis does not attribute the addresses to named institutions.
records.limitations: This is a secondary on-chain snapshot, not an Aave or Circle disclosure. The addresses are unlabeled; concentration does not establish common beneficial ownership, institutional identity or intent. Snapshot date is September 24, not current.
